description: Stage 1 is the broad diagnosis corpus. It attaches the framework contracts, control-plane docs, runtime scripts, task templates, modeling and hybrid contract surfaces, the operator retrospective, and the specific battle-test artifacts that reveal framework-wide strengths and failures. It intentionally excludes raw data, processed datasets, rendered paper binaries, broad status directories, and unrelated historical scaffolding so the stage sees the latest framework state and the actual battle-test evidence rather than a noisy dump of the whole empirical project.
